brief:
Occupation authorities have extended the detention of Dr. Hosam Abu Safiya, a physician, for an additional six months under the designation of "unlawful combatant," Shehab Wire reported. Abu Safiya remains held amid allegations of severe torture, according to the report.

The extension reflects what observers describe as a systematic targeting of medical personnel in Gaza. Healthcare workers have faced repeated arrest and detention throughout the conflict.
